description: Define and version CapabilityDto including activation state and policy mode references.
exit_criteria: Capability contract supports tenant scoped active and inactive visibility.

description: Define and version ToolGovernanceDto with risk class, certification state, environment scope, and policy ceilings.
exit_criteria: Tool governance contract supports allow, deny, and blocked reasons.

description: Extend TenantConfigDto for approved library changes and certified capability toggles.
exit_criteria: Tenant configuration contract enforces bounded option set.

title: Integrate Release 2 remote endpoints
description: Connect bitacora, capability, tool governance, and tenant config endpoints against remote staging.
exit_criteria: All Release 2 read and write paths run with remote adapters and typed mapping.

title: Implement governed bitacora flow
description: Implement bitacora timeline and evidence entry flow with before after rendering where required.
exit_criteria: Tecnico and supervisor create and view governed log entries with visible case history impact.

title: Implement tenant capability catalog surface
description: Implement capability catalog surfaces with tenant scoped active inactive state and policy mode visibility.
exit_criteria: Admin tenant sees only allowed capabilities and mapped policy posture.

title: Implement tool governance visibility and blocking
description: Implement tool governance visibility for internal actors and blocked execution messaging.
exit_criteria: Supervisor and admin views show risk, certification state, and execution constraints.

title: Implement bounded tenant parameter editing
description: Implement tenant parameter editing within closed library and certified capability toggles.
exit_criteria: Configuration writes apply only within guardrails and provide actionable validation feedback.

title: Extend Release 2 audit taxonomy
description: Extend audit taxonomy for bitacora writes, capability activation changes, tool policy decisions, and tenant config mutations.
exit_criteria: Taxonomy includes actor, tenant, before after, policy decision, and result status.

title: Enforce split governance boundaries
description: Enforce boundary rules so tenant admins cannot certify tools or override global policy ceilings.
exit_criteria: Allow and deny scenarios pass for boundary sensitive actions.

title: Correlate Release 2 audit IDs
description: Ensure every Release 2 mutation exposes correlated audit IDs in UI and API response metadata.
exit_criteria: Correlation IDs are visible and queryable for all sensitive operations.

title: Add Release 2 contract compatibility tests
description: Add schema and backward compatibility coverage for Release 2 DTOs.
exit_criteria: Contract suite passes in CI and staging smoke.

title: Add governance and guardrail integration tests
description: Add unit and integration coverage for evidence visibility, capability transitions, tool policy enforcement, and tenant guardrails.
exit_criteria: Integration suite validates allow deny blocked paths by role and tenant.

title: Add Release 2 role based e2e flows
description: Add role based flows for bitacora update, capability toggle, blocked tool execution, and tenant config change.
exit_criteria: Playwright e2e passes on mobile first and web first surfaces.

title: Add Release 2 visual and accessibility checks
description: Add mobile and desktop visual and accessibility checks for Release 2 surfaces and states.
exit_criteria: Visual and axe checks pass for loading, empty, error, success, and blocked states.

title: Run Release 2 staging gate and publish evidence
description: Run full extended regression and publish release evidence artifacts.
exit_criteria: CI and staging regression pass and request evidence is updated.
